metadata.description: Open-source marketing skills and agent workflows from Inference, an independent marketing studio for the AI rebuild.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Go-to-market and marketing strategy skills: positioning, point of view, messaging, ICP, growth models and bets, channel maps, ABM, pricing, naming, brand, selling systems, and the newsroom content pipeline. Each skill turns a piece of marketing practice into a repeatable workflow.

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Skills for thinking a hard call through before you commit: debate-room convenes independent expert personas, sharpen-strategy grills a plan to shared understanding, and pressure-test runs the go/no-go gate on one bet.

plugins.name: agentops
plugins.description: Skills for building and running an agent setup: deciding whether a need is a skill or an agent and designing it, handing context between sessions, and checking a thread is safe to close.

plugins.name: relay-loop
plugins.description: Run an issue from rough idea to merge-ready PR through a disciplined, human-gated agent loop (spec, build, independent review, fix rounds), then on through design checks, QA, a weekly release and a closing wrap. Each pass in a fresh context.
